description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named ListViewDraggingAnimation that creates a list view with draggable items allowing users to modify the order of the list via touch events. It initializes the list with cheese names and sets up a custom list view with drag-and-drop functionality.

classes.name: ListViewDraggingAnimation
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of cheese names in a ListView with drag-and-drop reordering functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list view with cheese data, and configures the list view for single choice mode.
